name: 03087 · Windham, NH
findings: ZIP 03087 (Windham) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03087 (Windham) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
